image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a crying infant lying on its back on a patterned bedsheet. The baby is wearing a white disposable diaper with colorful cartoon graphics (blue and orange characters) and blue adhesive tabs. A pink blanket or garment is visible under the baby's head/shoulders. In the background, there are baby toys: a yellow rattle and a blue/green plastic toy. The lighting appears to be indoor flash photography.
